question_text: For some transformation having kinetics that obey the Avrami equation (equation (y=1-\exp \left(-k t^n\right))), the parameter $n$ is known to have a value of 1.5. If the reaction is $25 \%$ complete after 125 s , how long (total time) will it take the transformation to go to $90 \%$ completion?The unit of the answer is s.
